evals.prompt: 用 pptxgenjs 帮我做一个 5 页的产品发布会 PPT：封面、问题、方案、路线图、致谢。给出完整脚本，配色用深蓝主题。
evals.expected_output: A CommonJS pptxgenjs script that sets the layout first, uses hex colors without #, builds the five slides and validates the file.
expectations: Uses require('pptxgenjs') and creates one new pptxgen() instance for the output
Sets pres.layout before adding slides and keeps coordinates within the 10 x 5.625 inch canvas (or the chosen layout)
Writes hex colors without # and without 8-digit alpha
Uses bullet: true for lists instead of literal bullet characters
Runs scripts/office/validate.py on the deck after writeFile()

evals.prompt: Add a stacked column chart of quarterly revenue by region (3 regions, 4 quarters) to a pptxgenjs slide, with data labels shown. Show the addChart call.
evals.expected_output: An addChart call for a stacked bar chart with a data label position allowed for stacked charts.
expectations: Uses addChart with a bar chart type and barGrouping set to stacked
Sets showValue: true with dataLabelPosition ctr, inEnd or inBase, not outEnd
Gives the chart a title and explicit chartColors

evals.prompt: 我想在现有的公司模板 template.pptx 基础上做一份新 deck：复制第 3 页版式做两页新内容，删掉模板里的示例页。步骤是什么？
evals.expected_output: Unpack, duplicate slides with add_slide.py, edit slideN.xml, update sldIdLst, run clean.py, rezip and validate with --original.
expectations: Uses scripts/add_slide.py to duplicate the slide with its package bookkeeping
Deletes or reorders slides by editing <p:sldIdLst> in ppt/presentation.xml
Runs scripts/clean.py after the slide list is final

evals.prompt: Each slide of my talk needs speaker notes with the script I will say. How do I add them with pptxgenjs?
evals.expected_output: Use slide.addNotes() once per slide with plain text, never a text box on the slide.
expectations: Does not put the speaker script into a text box on the slide

evals.prompt: 帮我把 deck.pptx 里每页的文字和备注提取出来，我要写会议纪要。
evals.expected_output: Reads slide text and notes with the read tool or scripts/slide_text.py, without modifying the deck.
expectations: Uses the read tool or scripts/slide_text.py to extract slide titles, text and speaker notes
Does not unpack or edit the deck for a read-only task
